method: built-in image_gen; whole new images only

prompts.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. A completely NEW camera-like image of the same Andoya rocket launch as the supplied reference. The reference establishes ONLY scene identity, launch timing, camera direction and color relationships. DO NOT copy its rendered-looking surface texture. This is a whole new generation, never a local edit, patch, texture filter, sharpen, denoise or crop.

Make the surface appearance convincingly like an unretouched photograph from a real camera: natural optical detail and restrained microcontrast. No CGI render, procedural normal maps, embossed/engraved surfaces, repeating cellular or crosshatched patterns, canvas/paper grain, painted smearing, over-sharpening, clarity halos, crunchy HDR or synthetic texture overlay. Do not replace one artificial grain with another.

Sea: physically varied overlapping wind waves of mixed sizes, irregular spacing and broken glints, natural blue/navy color and correct perspective reduction; smooth water between ripples with realistic Fresnel reflections. Avoid evenly carved ridges, identical repeating wavelets or rock-like watery texture. Rocks and fells: broad irregular geological forms and natural green vegetation at different scales, no tiled granular pattern or uniformly dotted/striated surface. Distant mountains lose fine detail naturally to atmosphere. Smoke: soft volumetric translucent folds with irregular turbulent scales, naturally scattering light, never a uniform pile of hard plastic cauliflower bubbles. Sky: smooth photographic blue gradients, naturally irregular cloud edges, no paper/canvas stipple. Very subtle sensor noise at most; no visible global grain texture.

Keep the SAME distinctive simple white slender two-stage rocket and small lattice service tower to its left, same vertical liftoff moment, brilliant white-yellow flame, white/soft-peach steam across the coastal platform, green-gray ridges (low flatter summit left, higher steep ridge right), blue sea foreground, blue upper sky and restrained warm light from the left. Same offshore view. A photographic landscape illustration, not a different launcher, different launch or new city. All major objects visible with credible scale. Preserve the natural cool-blue/warm-accent balance; do not turn it into an orange scene. Avoid the sun becoming a giant theatrical starburst.

No text, letters, logos, flags, numbers, watermark, borders, UI or phone island. No vignette. Keep lower-center sea composition quiet enough for the game to add its own name later, but draw no name. Real-world photographic plausibility and irregular natural surfaces take priority over excessive digital crispness. This is an AI-made illustration that should LOOK camera-photographic, not a claim that it documents a real launch.
